plot_beats: Rangers of the Night's Watch beyond the Wall are attacked by White Walkers; one survivor deserts.
Lord Eddard 'Ned' Stark of Winterfell beheads the deserter, who insists he saw White Walkers.
The Starks find a litter of direwolf pups, one for each Stark child, including Ned's bastard son Jon Snow.
King Robert Baratheon arrives at Winterfell with Queen Cersei Lannister and asks Ned to replace the late Jon Arryn as Hand of the King.
A letter from Catelyn's sister Lysa claims the Lannisters murdered Jon Arryn.
Across the sea, Viserys Targaryen marries his sister Daenerys to the Dothraki warlord Khal Drogo in exchange for an army; the exiled knight Jorah Mormont pledges himself to them.
Bran Stark, climbing a tower, sees Cersei having sex with her twin brother Jaime; Jaime pushes Bran out of the window.

characters.new_info: Asked to become Hand of the King
relationships: father of Robb, Sansa, Arya, Bran and Rickon

characters.name: Catelyn Stark
characters.new_info: Receives Lysa's warning about the Lannisters

characters.name: Robert Baratheon
characters.new_info: Asks Ned to be his Hand

characters.name: Cersei Lannister
characters.new_info: Secretly sleeping with her twin Jaime

characters.name: Jaime Lannister
characters.new_info: Pushes Bran from the tower to hide the affair

characters.name: Daenerys Targaryen
characters.new_info: Married off by her brother; given three dragon eggs as a wedding gift

characters.name: Viserys Targaryen
characters.role: Exiled heir of the deposed royal family
characters.new_info: Trades his sister for an army

summary.cliffhanger: Jaime pushes Bran out of the tower window.

plot_beats: Bran lies in a coma.
Ned leaves for King's Landing with his daughters Sansa and Arya; Jon heads to the Wall to join the Night's Watch, travelling with Tyrion Lannister.
Jon gives Arya a small sword she names Needle.
An assassin tries to kill Bran; Catelyn fights him off and Bran's direwolf kills him. The assassin's dagger is unusually fine.
On the road, Arya's direwolf Nymeria bites Prince Joffrey when he attacks Arya; Arya drives Nymeria away.
Cersei demands a wolf be killed, and Ned kills Sansa's direwolf Lady himself; the Hound kills Arya's friend Mycah.

characters.name: Arya Stark
characters.new_info: Receives the sword Needle from Jon

characters.name: Joffrey Baratheon
characters.new_info: Lies about the fight with Arya

characters.name: Tyrion Lannister
characters.new_info: Visits the Wall out of curiosity

characters.name: Catelyn Stark
characters.new_info: Fights off an assassin sent for Bran

relationships_changed: Tension between the Starks and the Lannisters grows
open_threads: Who sent the assassin after Bran?

plot_beats: Ned joins the small council in King's Landing and learns the crown is deep in debt, much of it to the Lannisters.
Catelyn comes to King's Landing in secret; Petyr 'Littlefinger' Baelish claims the assassin's dagger belonged to Tyrion.
At Castle Black, Jon struggles to fit in among the recruits.
Arya begins sword lessons with Syrio Forel.
Bran wakes but cannot walk and remembers nothing of the fall.
Daenerys learns she is pregnant.
summary.cliffhanger: Daenerys tells Jorah she is pregnant.

plot_beats: Tyrion gives Bran a design for a saddle that would let him ride.
At the Wall, Samwell Tarly arrives and Jon protects him from the other recruits.
Ned's investigation into Jon Arryn's death leads him to a blacksmith's apprentice, Gendry, King Robert's unacknowledged son.
Viserys is humiliated by the Dothraki as Daenerys gains confidence.
Ser Gregor Clegane, 'the Mountain', kills a knight in the Hand's tourney.
Catelyn encounters Tyrion at an inn and has him arrested for the attempt on Bran's life.

characters.name: Gregor Clegane
characters.new_info: Kills a knight in the tourney

characters.name: Tyrion Lannister
characters.new_info: Accused of trying to kill Bran

open_threads: Why was Jon Arryn looking for Robert's bastards?
How will the Lannisters respond to Tyrion's arrest?
summary.cliffhanger: Catelyn has Tyrion seized at the inn.

plot_beats: At the tourney, the Hound saves Ser Loras Tyrell from his brother the Mountain.
Catelyn takes Tyrion to her sister Lysa at the Eyrie, where he is imprisoned.
Arya overhears Varys and another man discussing a coming war.
Robert orders Daenerys assassinated after learning she is pregnant; Ned refuses to be part of it and resigns as Hand.
In retaliation for Tyrion's arrest, Jaime attacks Ned in the street; Ned's guard Jory is killed and Ned is wounded.

characters.name: Lysa Arryn
characters.new_info: Imprisons Tyrion in a sky cell

characters.name: Loras Tyrell
characters.new_info: Saved by the Hound; secretly in a relationship with Renly

relationships_changed: Open conflict between Stark and Lannister men
open_threads: Tyrion is a prisoner at the Eyrie
summary.cliffhanger: Jaime's men kill Jory and Ned is left wounded in the street.

plot_beats: Robert reinstates Ned as Hand.
Ned strips the Mountain of his titles for raiding the Riverlands.
Bran is attacked by wildlings in the woods and saved by Robb and Theon Greyjoy; a wildling woman, Osha, is taken prisoner.
Tyrion demands a trial by combat; the sellsword Bronn fights for him and wins, and Tyrion is released.
Viserys threatens Daenerys and demands his crown; Khal Drogo pours molten gold over his head, killing him.
Reading a book of family lineages, Ned realizes something about Joffrey's parentage.

characters.name: Viserys Targaryen
characters.new_info: Killed by Drogo with molten gold

open_threads: Ned suspects Joffrey is not Robert's son
summary.cliffhanger: Ned, studying the lineage book, grasps the truth about Robert's heirs.

plot_beats: Tywin Lannister tells Jaime to lead an army against the Starks.
Ned tells Cersei he knows her children are Jaime's and urges her to flee before he tells Robert.
Robert is gored by a boar while hunting and, dying, names Ned Lord Protector until Joffrey comes of age; Ned writes 'rightful heir' instead of Joffrey's name.
Robert dies. Ned asks Littlefinger to secure the City Watch.
At the Wall, Jon takes his vows but is made steward to Lord Commander Mormont rather than a ranger.
After a wine merchant tries to poison Daenerys, Drogo vows to invade the Seven Kingdoms.
In the throne room, Ned challenges Joffrey's claim; Littlefinger betrays him, and the City Watch turns on Ned's men.

characters.name: Tywin Lannister
relationships: father of Cersei, Jaime and Tyrion

characters.name: Eddard Stark
characters.new_info: Challenges Joffrey's right to the throne

summary.cliffhanger: Littlefinger holds a knife to Ned's throat: 'I did warn you not to trust me.'

plot_beats: Lannister soldiers slaughter the Stark household in King's Landing.
Syrio Forel holds off Lannister guards so Arya can escape; she flees into the city.
Sansa is kept by Cersei and persuaded to write to Robb urging him to come and swear fealty to Joffrey.
Robb calls the northern lords to war and marches south.
Tyrion wins the support of the hill tribes by promising them land and weapons.
At the Wall, a dead ranger rises and attacks Lord Commander Mormont; Jon destroys it with fire, burning his hand.
Daenerys stops the Dothraki from raping captured villagers and protects the healer Mirri Maz Duur.
Drogo is wounded fighting one of his riders, Mago, and kills him; Mirri treats Drogo's wound.
Before the court, Sansa begs Joffrey to show her father mercy; Joffrey says he will if Ned confesses.

characters.name: Khal Drogo
characters.new_info: Wounded in a fight; his wound is treated by Mirri

relationships_changed: The Starks and Lannisters are at war
open_threads: Ned is imprisoned and his fate is undecided
summary.cliffhanger: Joffrey tells Sansa he will be merciful if Ned confesses his crimes.

forbidden.event: Robb proclaimed King in the North
Jaime captured at the Whispering Wood
